name: Strider, Ranger of the North — a 2/2 target gets +1/+1 but no first strike
notes: "target creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn. Then if that creature has power 4 or greater, it gains first strike until end of turn." (2026-10-07) The "Then if" sentence is its own conditional line sharing the one target; the power test reads the target as the ability resolved (fire-time state plus this ability's own +1/+1), not the live value in layer 6. Grizzly Bears 2/2: 3/3, no first strike.
